I'm telling you now so you can choose with full information.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. If I end up with all 4, I'll operate with you afterward so the reserve can rebuild for you if the storms allow. I'll report honestly what I see in the reserve.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
